summary: Require declared exact or wildcard endpoint budgets and fail closed when no declared policy matches.
reason: Gate C0 must never invent pacing or retry policy for an undeclared endpoint class; the checked-in provenance inventory distinguishes published constraints from conservative internal fallbacks, exact overrides take precedence, and long provider Retry-After values remain authoritative.
validated_outcome: Exact-first lookup, wildcard cloning, typed missing-budget errors, bounded safe retries, and uncapped provider Retry-After behavior are covered by deterministic client tests, and the fleet verifier prevents adapter and provenance-inventory drift.
